answer_1.quote: We introduce PIIvot, an anonymization framework that balances the trade-off between precision and recall in PII identification, suitable for contexts where the content of overlapping non-PII entities doesn't impact dataset integrity. PIIvot enabled the open sourcing of QATD 2k to support future research on effective math tutoring.

answer_4.quote: The first and second authors and two tutors from the original initiative independently applied the codebook to 68,717 messages and 1000 questions. Discrepancies between the machine and annotator labels were resolved to establish a ground truth.
